description:
The `XMLHelper` module at the top of `src/fetcher/rss_parser.cr` (lines 6-39) is a collection of generic XML utility methods (`xpath_text`, `find_child`, `find_attr`, `find_link`, `extract_href`). None of its methods are RSS-specific — they're reusable for any XML processing.

Problems with current location:
- Lives inside `rss_parser.cr`, requiring that file to be loaded whenever the helper is needed.
- Couples unrelated XML utility to RSS/Atom parsing.
- Forces other code (e.g., `json_feed.cr`, `software/*.cr` if they grow XML handling) to either duplicate these helpers or take an awkward dependency on `rss_parser.cr`.

Action:
1. Create `src/fetcher/xml_helper.cr` with the `Fetcher::XMLHelper` module (verbatim from rss_parser.cr).
2. Add `require "./xml_helper"` at the top of `rss_parser.cr` and remove the inline module definition.
3. Run `crystal spec` to confirm no behavior change.

Acceptance: `git diff --stat` shows the module moved (no content change), and the full spec suite passes.
title: Move XMLHelper module to its own file
